targets.query: from(bucket: "hvac") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac" and r._field == "blower_power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hvac") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac" and r._field == "blower_current") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

options.content: Status and controller mode are not stored in InfluxDB and are unavailable here. Missing or stale data is unknown, not an alarm. Blower topics and units require device verification; power/current do not prove airflow. Controller recommendations are not actuator position or safety interlocks.
